source: Ayush Bhai branch — focused two-symbol build (NIFTY 50 + SENSEX)
notes: spot_token holds the XTS instrument id for the index spot. NIFTY (NSE) = 26000 on NSECM. SENSEX (BSE) is resolved at runtime from /instruments/indexlist on BSECM (segment 11). exchange drives the NSE-vs-BSE segment selection across scripmaster/symbol_controller/ws_client. lot_size and strike_step are hints — actual values come from the instrument master at subscription time.
